input.description: Telemetry shows oil pressure steadily declining from 35.7 psi to ~18 psi over 90 minutes, then plateauing at a low, stable 18-19 psi while RPM (1600-1700) and coolant temp/level remain normal and steady — this is a sustained real drop, not sensor noise. KB-004 (diesel_engine, oil pressure warning) states this pattern is "not resolved by sensor restart" and recommends schedule_service_visit; only one matching KB entry was found, no conflicting entries. Service history shows the oil pressure sensor was already replaced in March for an unrelated fault, making a recurring sensor issue less likely and supporting a mechanical cause (pump/oil level/filter) requiring inspection.
